description: Submission of Colombo Port City (Guidelines on Grant of Exemptions or Incentives to Businesses of Strategic Importance) Regulations, No.01 of 2025, to Parliament for Approval
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-10-13 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2025-07-07 to issue Regulations under the Colombo Port City Economic Commission Act, No.11 of 2021 to introduce a new incentive mechanism, enabling to implement tax incentives for primary businesses of strategic importance operating within the Colombo Port City, in accordance with the agreements entered into by the Government under the Extended Fund Facility of the International Monetary Fund. Accordingly, the 'Colombo Port City (Guidelines on Grant of Exemptions or Incentives to Businesses of Strategic Importance) Regulations, No.01 of 2025' has been published by the Gazette Extraordinary Notification No.2454/62 dated 2025-09-20. The proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development to submit the said Regulations to Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.
